data.one_liner: Translate GPS location data to geo-magnetic data such as magnetic declination.
data.what_it_does: Processes GPS coordinates and time into geo-magnetic data like magnetic declination using World Magnetic Model coefficients. It calculates the difference between true north and magnetic north using bundled or custom data.
use_when: You need to calculate magnetic declination from GPS coordinates in your app.
You are building navigation or compass features that require true north versus magnetic north adjustments.
avoid_when: You just need standard map rendering or geocoding without magnetic calculations.
You require real-time hardware compass sensor streams rather than coordinate-based magnetic data.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited in scope to geo-magnetic calculations.
Relies on periodic coefficient updates for long-term accuracy.
